name: Grammar Rule & Practice
description: One grammar point taught properly: the rule, right vs wrong side by side, a transformation worked through, the common error, and practice.
audience: Tenses, voice, narration, articles, prepositions in any language.

signals.why: your words are about a grammar point

slides.guidance: Lesson title for {topic} and a short subtitle that names the class level.
Students will be able to use {topic} correctly in their own sentences.
The rule of {topic} in one plain sentence, with one example sentence.
Correct and incorrect sentences side by side, with what changes.
Change one sentence using the rule, step by step.
The most common mistake with {topic} and the correct form.

variants.guidance: A classroom meme about {topic}. Pick one format from MEME FORMATS that matches the idea, write captions a {grade} student finds funny and that make the correct idea easier to remember. Kind to students, never about a person.

slides.guidance: The rule, one example, and the mistake to avoid.
